'''Elite royal crusaders''' were upgraded variants of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Royal crusader]] and were members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. They were outfitted at Security Force [[Fortress/Legends|Fortresses]]. During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of Naboo in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], three elite royal crusaders were [[Prison/Legends|captured]] and held at [[Camp 14]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The camp was [[Liberation of Spinnaker|raided]] by elements of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]], and during the raid the three crusaders and the other prisoners revolted and escaped.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Elite royal crusaders appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The game's campaign was also included in its [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. They are encountered during the Gungan campaign, and the player has the option of rescuing them from prison, although it is not the primary mission objective.
